title: Board of Pharmacy compliance as a condition on the prescribing power
rule_summary: The first requirement in 105 CMR 700.003(G) is that the pharmacist MEETS ALL APPLICABLE REQUIREMENTS OF THE BOARD OF REGISTRATION IN PHARMACY established in accordance with M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24, and 247 CMR 1.00 THROUGH 16.00. The condition is not confined to the collaborative practice regulation; it reaches every applicable Board requirement across that range.
exam_relevance: Tests that a Board of Pharmacy failure anywhere in 247 CMR 1.00 through 16.00 defeats the Department's prescribing power, so the qualification and practice standards regulations are conditions on prescribing rather than a separate compartment.

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

common_confusions: The reference is to 247 CMR 1.00 through 16.00, not to 247 CMR 16.00 alone.
verification_notes: Read in the current official publication of 105 CMR 700.000 at the Department of Public Health download link on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule rather than by changing an existing record, so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
